gloss: grilling net; grill rack; wire grill

definitions.gloss: grilling net; grill rack; wire grill
definitions.explanation: A wire mesh or metal grid used for grilling food over a flame or heat source.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{網|あみ}の{上|うえ}に{肉|にく}を{載|の}せた。
examples.english: I placed the meat on the grilling net.

examples.japanese: バーベキューの{前|まえ}に{焼|や}き{網|あみ}を{油|あぶら}で{塗|ぬ}っておく。
examples.english: Before the barbecue, oil the grilling net in advance.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{終|お}わった{焼|や}き{網|あみ}は{熱|あつ}いうちにブラシで{汚|よご}れを{落|お}とすとよい。
examples.english: It's best to scrub the grill net with a brush while it's still hot after use.

notes:
A kitchen and outdoor cooking tool, essential for Japanese-style grilling such as {焼|や}き{魚|ざかな} (grilled fish) and yakiniku. Also commonly used at barbecues and camping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{網|あみ}に{載|の}せる — to place on the grill
- {焼|や}き{網|あみ}を{洗|あら}う — to wash the grill net
- {焼|や}き{網|あみ}を{交換|こうかん}する — to replace the grill rack
- {使|つか}い{捨|す}て{焼|や}き{網|あみ} — disposable grill net

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {網|あみ} — net (general term)
- {鉄板|てっぱん} — iron plate (for teppanyaki-style grilling, flat surface rather than mesh)
